_about: What makes a course question sound AI-written instead of like us. Read by scripts/study/voice_lint.py. Built 2026-11-17 from every review note the owner has given (docs/study/REVIEW_LEARNINGS.md rules 16, 19, 21, 25-28; docs/study/VOICE.md sections 6 and 10). 'hard' tells must be zero in any lesson we rework; 'soft' tells are counted and kept rare. Add a tell here when a new note names one, with his words in 'from'.

hard.instead: Say what we look for as ours: 'we want three taps', 'we look for'. A member never sees our setup cards.
hard.from: rule 22 (scanner numbers are not trading rules); our card is internal

hard.instead: 'our rules', or just state the rule as ours: 'Below the 200-day we don't buy stocks.'
Plain words. Decision numbers and our 'criteria' files are working material, not the course. (A member's own criteria, in plain English, is fine.)

hard.from: 'quit calling us THE FIRM'; 'don't use the word stock talk'

hard.instead: A comma, a period, or keep talking.

hard.pattern: ^(Our rule\??|By our guide\b)|\bour rule\?\s*$|fits our rule|one thing you never do|Our card's name
hard.instead: Ask what a trader would ask at the screen: 'Do you buy it?', 'Where's your stop?', 'What's this telling you?'

hard.pattern: lifts? the grade|primary stop|catch(es|ing)? its breath|let the trade come to you|at every timeframe|buyers (are )?(still )?in control|the level it must trade through|it'?s important to|it is important to|in order to|key takeaway|it is worth noting|may potentially|\butilize|\brobust\b|\bcrucial\b|\bcomprehensive\b|\bframework\b|\bdive in(to)?\b|great job
hard.instead: Say it the way you'd say it across the desk. See VOICE.md section 10.

soft.instead: Choices are short plain options ('Just the A+', 'All three, full size'), not 'No; ...' clauses.
Teach it as ours, from the chart and the numbers. A source belongs in 'deeper' unless the question is about that trader's principle (rule 13).
Contractions are fine and sound like a person: 'That's the stop.'
Say what we do. Where it really depends, say what it depends on.
